task.title: Resolve CIS manual-review items
task.shortdesc: Find CIS recommendations requiring manual review and decide whether to configure, document, or leave them for external verification.

prereq.p: Open All settings Review mode for a profile that includes a CIS layer or CIS-derived source metadata.

context.p: Some CIS recommendations cannot be fully automated by BPM. Review mode surfaces those items so the user can make an explicit decision without claiming certification.

step.cmd: Open Review mode and filter for CIS manual-review items if needed.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Read the recommendation identifiers, affected policy or preference, and current value.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Configure a supported value, document why manual verification remains, or leave the item intentionally unresolved.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Revalidate and record the decision before export or handoff.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: CIS manual-review items are configured, documented, or intentionally left for external verification.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the recommendation cannot be mapped to a visible setting, keep the item in review and consult the CIS guide when that guide is authored.
